claims.text: THE DOMAIN'S ORGANISING FINDING AFTER THE PROPULSION STRAND OF 19 SEPTEMBER 2026, and it is a stated inference over documents rather than a claim about physics. For each propulsion mechanism the literature invokes, a document is named; when the document is opened it says less than is claimed for it, and usually something else entirely. Brown's two patents contain the word 'gravity' zero times. Alcubierre's 1994 paper contains the word 'device' zero times and states in its own abstract that exotic matter will be needed. King's 1967 patent contains 'scalar' zero times and has no assignee and no government interest. DIA's own antigravity survey does not mention Brown. THE STRAND RECORDS THE GAP BETWEEN CITATIONS AND DOCUMENTS AND TAKES NO POSITION ON WHETHER EXOTIC PROPULSION IS POSSIBLE.

connections.note: THE PATENT ITSELF IS NOT EXOTIC. It is a linear induction motor using ionised air as its armature, which is classical electromagnetism. It sits in this domain solely because it was cited as evidence for scalar physics, and the strand's product is the gap between the citation and the document.

desc: The most tractable question in this whole field is not whether exotic physics is real but who was paid to study it, and that question has a documented answer. Between 2008 and 2010 the Defense Intelligence Agency commissioned thirty-eight Defense Intelligence Reference Documents under AAWSAP, released under FOIA, on subjects including 'Advanced Space Propulsion Based on Vacuum (Spacetime Metric) Engineering', 'Traversable Wormholes, Stargates, and Negative Energy' by Eric W. Davis of EarthTech International, and 'Antigravity for Aerospace Applications'. Those are real government contract deliverables on precisely the physics a recovered craft would require, written by named authors, with document control numbers. Two readings are available and this board records both: either the topics were selected because someone had a reason to believe they were relevant, or a sympathetic programme manager funded a literature survey of fringe physics. The strength of the domain is that it does not depend on resolving that - the tasking itself is the tier-1 fact. Scoring high here means an entity authored, commissioned or reviewed this body of work.

timeline.label: DIA buys the physics
timeline.text: The Defense Intelligence Agency issues solicitation HHM402-08-R-0211 for the Advanced Aerospace Weapon System Applications Program. The resulting contract produces thirty-eight Defense Intelligence Reference Documents on metric engineering, wormholes, antigravity and field effects on human tissue - the tier-1 evidence that a US agency paid to study the physics a recovered craft would require.
